entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [API Proposal]: DynamicILInfo-like API for dynamic assemblies #124733
  • Timeout in System.Security.Cryptography.Tests.CryptoStreamTests.ReadWrite_Success #124732
  • WasmEmitTypeScriptDefinitions makes builds non-incremental #124729
  • Slow restore of packages in dotnet/runtime #124727
  • [API Proposal]: Should not be in `MarshalMode` enum `UnmanagedToManagedReturn` option to avoid the analyzer to complain `SYSLIB1057` about the missing function? #124726
  • System.Diagnostics.Tests.ProcessModuleTests.LongModuleFileNamesAreSupported fails in runtime-nativeaot-outerloop #124723
  • FileStream.Flush(flushToDisk: true) causes corrupt (truncated) files to be written on macOS + SMB share #124722
  • ILC fails to pre-initialize pointer fields to pre-initialized memory sections #124719
  • [API Proposal]: Adding a ToPascalCase() extension method #124717

Closed

  • SequenceReader.TryCopyMultisegment has incorrect bounds check #29380
  • Single-file running from "admin" location may load code from "non-admin" location #39177
  • System.DirectoryServices.Protocols - SendRequest fails in Linux when TimeLimit is set on the request #46125
  • DiagnosticSource listener/event names for SqlClient and other ADO providers #26085
  • DynamicILInfo::GetTokenFor returns TypeDefinition where it should be a reference #124708
  • Allow Span<T> to accept uint as index #124718
  • [DAC-Linux] Dac private interface crashes with some benign inputs #124640
